_howto: Creator Library manifest. Add items to the arrays below, then commit + push (the partner page fetches this file — no code changes needed). Schemas — videos: {title, desc, url, thumb, added}. downloads: {title, desc, url, type, size, added}. copy: {group, title, text, added} where group is one of hooks|captions|ctas|scripts. 'added' is a YYYY-MM-DD date and drives the NEW badge for 14 days. Delete the examples in _examples and paste real items into videos/downloads/copy.
